question: What was the yearly trend in unit value (price per kg) of the top 3 mineral fuel products (HS4) that showed the largest changes in import value between 2021 and 2022 in Luxembourg from 2018 to 2023?

limitations.message: Quantities are missing for part of the trade, so volumes and unit values cover only rows with a known quantity.

sql:
SELECT
  year AS period,
  flow,
  SUM(value_eur) AS value_eur,
  SUM(qty_kg) AS qty_kg,
  SUM(value_eur) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT qty_kg IS NULL) AS value_eur_with_qty
FROM v_lu_trade
WHERE
  period >= CAST('2018-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND period < CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND flow = 'import'
  AND hs4 IN ('2710', '2701', '2715')
GROUP BY
  year,
  flow
ORDER BY
  period
LIMIT 10000
title: imports: +36.7 % (2018–2023)
insight: The yearly trend in unit value of the top 3 mineral fuel products imported by Luxembourg increased from 0.53 €/kg in 2018 to 0.73 €/kg in 2023.
This represents a total increase of 36.7% over the period.
The highest unit value was recorded in 2022, reaching 0.85 €/kg.
The data shows a peak in 2022 followed by a decrease in 2023.
However, quantities are missing for part of the trade, so these unit values only cover imports with known quantities.
